headline: Fort Hays State completes an unbeaten conference season
dek: Fort Hays State won eleven and drew one of its twelve conference matches for 34 points, the draw at Rogers State the only points it dropped. Rogers State and Northeastern State finished level on nineteen points, fifteen behind.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State's 32 goals are more than Harding and Newman have managed between them.

wire.line: Fort Hays State holds eighteen wins, three draws, and two losses as its season continues.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's home match against UT Dallas is past its date with no result published, the only such match in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Harding drew one and lost seventeen, and finished the season without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Guilherme Borges has kept four shutouts for Newman.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rogers State has had at least seventeen different scorers this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Payton Roehrich has made 58 saves and conceded nine goals for Fort Hays State.

last_match.line: Fort Hays State extended its unbeaten run against a Lincoln side that had beaten Northeastern State in August.

next_match.line: Flagler has not faced a GAC side this season; Fort Hays State has not lost since early September.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
